doc: Each pattern only exempts a number when the regex match actually covers that number's characters,
so a pattern that matches somewhere else on the line does nothing. Every pattern must stay narrow:
name one specific hyperparameter or protocol constant, never a whole category of numbers.
Patterns are for NUMBERS THAT ARE NOT RESULTS: training settings, protocol constants, footprints.
If a number is a result, it needs a RESULTS-INDEX.json entry and a num: marker -- not a pattern here.
Anything added here is printed in the audit report under 'Extra patterns', so it stays visible.
